[[File:Uueg_Tching_Sayings_SWAJ14.png|thumb|right|250px|Uueg Tching's Sayings]]
The '''''Sayings''''' were a series of scrolls composing a collection of the didactic and gnomic precepts of the 54th [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of the [[Kitel Phard Dynasty]] on [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], [[Uueg Tching]], from the [[Third Atrisian period]]. Uueg's wisdom regarding the strategic use of power, diplomacy and espionage was admired thousands of years later, throughout the whole [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

Court scribes recorded Uueg's pronouncements, parables, analogies and advices<ref name="WW" /> originally private communications to his heirs. The scrolls were written in black ink, with marginal comments in another hand in red. These were believed to be in Uueg's own handwriting. 
According to Dr. [[Milanda Vorgan]], the scrolls were later annotated by Uueg himself.<ref name="WW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

Around [[1500 BBY]] the ''Sayings'' were converted into a print form for the Atrisian nobility as a propaganda effort by the then-Atrisian emperor. In [[539 BBY]] the [[Atrisian Parliament]], which had wrested power away from the last emperor, made the texts available in public databases and reproduced in a limited printing. According to Vorgan, the Parliament, with this move, wanted to show-off the authority it had replaced.<ref name="WW" />

The ''Sayings'' displayed a practical (but callous, according to Vorgan) wisdom which intrigued several beings in the wider galaxy. One of them was the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Special Acquisitions Branch]] of the [[Library of the Republic]], [[Tra-Skan-Lor]], who made his subordinates study the ''Sayings'', making it part of the personnel culture throughout the Branch ever since. The later [[Infiltration]] branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] particularly appreciated UUeng Tching. This popularity gave the ancient [[Atrisian script]] some informal use within the SAB, which became formal in the later [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="WW" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] requested the original scrolls from Atrisia. They were briefly displayed at the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Imperial Museum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before disappearing into [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] private [[Imperial Palace Vaults|vaults]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] forces approached Imperial Center, the scrolls were loaded with much of the rest of the Emperor's collection on shuttles sent toward the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Several of these shuttles never reached [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] but, whether the ''Sayings'' were amongst those artifacts which survived the destruction of that planet was unknown. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] speculated in an address to the Galactic Museum that the recovery of the scrolls would greatly aid the New Republic in obtaining the support of the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]].
